name: EPSY 5324
title: Professional Orientation to Mental Health Counseling
description: Orientation to the field of mental health counseling. Topics include, history of mental health counseling, developing a professional identity, understanding mental health delivery systems and practices and current challenges and issues in mental health counseling. In addition, this course will have students examine how mental health counseling and mental health services can be more equitable and accessible for all populations, specifically those from underrepresented communities.
requirement_description: Instructor consent required. Open only to students in the LPC Certificate program.
